text:
incident-bot: ALERT 1999990123 - Elevated 5xx rate detected for control-plane org-lookup (gateway 502s). Pager: production-controlplane

leah.k: Oncall, @oncall-sre — I'm seeing a spike in 5xx from org-lookup behind the gateway. Customers reporting failed workspace lookups. Paging now. :rotating_light:

oncall-sre: got it, taking it. what's the scope? any known recent deploys?

leah.k: config-sync rolled a new change ~12m ago to increase consistency checks. Also a billing-proxy config bumped timeout to 2s.

samir: looking at traces — large tail latencies from org-lookup -> config-store read. lots of timeouts at ~1.9s. tracer link: https://ops.link/traces/abc123

devon: logs from gateway:
```
2026-03-14T21:02:45Z gateway ERROR upstream_502 service=org-lookup id=56a3
2026-03-14T21:02:46Z gateway WARN retrying route /v1/orgs/::500
```

oncall-sre: initial hypothesis: config-store (consul/sync) causing slow reads leading org-lookup to return 5xx. Will try to re-enable cache TTL and reduce config-store read rate.

leah.k: immediate mitigation — can we flip orglookup_fallback_v2 flag to return cached records for 60s while we stabilize? :thumbsup:

samir: yes. I can patch the feature-flag to fallback cached response. Doing now.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: starting rollout of toggle orglookup_fallback_v2 to ON for production (canary 10%)

devon: also let's scale org-lookup replicas x2 and increase concurrency queue to avoid head-of-line blocking. I'll run a scaling job.

oncall-sre: can we also add a temporary gateway circuit-breaker to fail fast and return 503 with retry-after to clients that can handle retries? otherwise downstream continously overloads org-lookup.

leah.k: agreed. product-ops, can you prepare a short customer impact note? need to inform sales and support.

product-ops: Draft: "We are investigating intermittent 5xx errors for account/org lookup calls affecting workspace access for a subset of API requests in EU region. Engineers have applied a cached fallback and are scaling services; impact should reduce shortly. We'll update in 30 mins." Anyone want to modify?

samir: cache-fallback toggle is at 15% canary progressing. Gateway circuit-breaker applied to prod region-eu. org-lookup replica scale started.

devon: scaling completed. observed traffic drop to org-lookup backend by ~70% due to cache + circuit-breaker. 5xx rate down from 4.2% to 0.9% in last 2m. dashboard: https://ops.link/dashboards/controlplane-errors

oncall-sre: running smoke tests for common flows: create workspace, list orgs, billing lookup. All green in canary region. Will widen toggle to 100% after 5 more mins.

incident-bot: Update: pager -> acknowledged. Severity set to Sev2. Incident channel: #incidents. Handoff in 45m if no regression.

leah.k: thanks team. leaving oncall handoff note: if errors creep above 1.5% revert orglookup_fallback_v2 and re-open circuit-breaker tuning. Also file a postmortem to review config-sync behavior.

oncall-sre: expanding toggle to 100% now.

samir: done. 100% fallback in prod. monitoring for error-rate and p50/p99 latencies.

devon: central logs show reduced 502s to ~0.3% and downstream telemetry normalized. continuing to monitor for 30m before close.

product-ops: customer note posted to #support-updates and pinged key AE contacts. :white_check_mark:

leah.k: updating incident tracker: mitigation applied (cache fallback + cb + scale). root cause suspected: config-sync read amplification + lowered timeouts in billing-proxy. Will assign owners for follow-ups.

oncall-sre: closing active paging but keeping an eye. handoff to night oncall (samir) at 00:30 UTC. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

samir: grabbing handoff. I'll continue monitoring and add runbook steps for future toggles.

incident-bot: Incident 1999990123 status -> mitigated (monitoring).
